dataset.name: SPRUCE S1 Bog Vegetation Allometric and Biomass Data: 2010-2011
description: This data set reports the results of measurements on sampled aboveground tissues of trees (Picea mariana and Larix laricina), shrubs (Ledum, Chamaedaphne, and Vaccinium), and ground layer vegetation (all species) of the S1 Bog, (home to the Minnesota SPRUCE Experiment Site), in areas adjacent to planned experimental study plots. Ground layer vegetation was sampled from both hummocks and hollows, within a 0.25 m2 plot, to evaluate total standing biomass of bog vegetation at or near the peak of annual production. Vegetation was harvested, processed, and measured in July of 2010 and again in June of 2011.

Dimensional measurements of the harvested plant materials were collected as described in methods and subsequent dry mass or wet/dry mass relationships obtained for all tissues. These data provided the basis for the development of allometric relationships defining equations between stem dimensional measurements (e.g., stem circumference of basal area) and plant dry mass of components (stems, branches, leaves).
Updated November 6, 2019. Please see included documentation for details.

measurementTechnique:
Shrub Harvests:
Individual shrubs of Ledum groenlandicum, Chamaedaphne calyculata, and Vaccinium spp. were collected from the bog after cutting their stem at the bog/Sphagunm surface. The following dimensional measurements were made for each plant:
Basal diameter (mm) obtained with a digital caliper;
Number of branches;
Crown height (cm); and
Crown diameter (cm).
Individual plants were then separated into current year old stem and foliage growth, 1-year-old stem and foliage growth, and other woody material. Wet tissue samples were frozen and then shipped to Oak Ridge, Tennessee. Dry mass of samples (g) was determined after drying overnight at 65 degrees C.

Ground-level Vegetation Harvests:
Plots for sampling “above Sphagnum” vegetation, to evaluate total standing mass of bog vegetation at or near the peak of annual production, were selected away from tree dominated areas of the bog. At the selected hummock and hollow locations, all vegetation above the bog/Sphagunm surface was clipped within a 0.25 m2 plot (a square 0.5 m on a side). Once collected the material was sorted by species into leaf and wood components as appropriate.
The samples from the following species were collected:
Picea mariana seedlings (those < 0.2 m tall)
Larix laricina seedlings (those < 0.2 m tall)
Ledum groenlandicum
Chamaedaphne calyculata
Vaccinium angustifolium (blue berry)
Kalmia polifolia
Vaccinium oxycoccus (cranberry)
Eriophorum spp.
Smilacina trifolia
Misc. Forbes.
Current year foliage and stems was separated from older stems and needle foliage if possible. Only four total plots were sampled in 2010 at the southern end of the S1 Bog. In 2001, two hummock-hollow paired plots were sampled per each of the four transects (16 plots total) of the SPRUCE experimental design.
